truth_boundary: Curated seed opportunities from public sources. This is not exhaustive coverage and does not establish eligibility.

items.headline: BSI PRAKI — Prüfanforderungen für LLM-basierte Agentic AI
items.buyer_or_program: Bundesamt für Sicherheit in der Informationstechnik
items.why_fit: The tender asks for Agentic-AI use cases and test requirements. Existing work on tool compliance, human approval, replayability, evals, evidence and trust boundaries maps unusually well to the brief.
blockers: Confirm whether solo bidder is credible or partner/consortium is needed
action_pack: Download and review complete tender documents
Build requirement-to-proof matrix using existing reliability demos
Identify one established security/public-sector partner if references are insufficient
Go/no-go within 48 hours

items.headline: Berliner Startup Stipendium BSS VI
items.potential: Non-dilutive founder stipend, coaching, workspace and network
items.why_fit: Berlin-based early startup work with a technology and societal-impact angle is closely aligned with Citizen Agents and trustworthy digital-worker infrastructure.
blockers: Check team/founder eligibility and current company status
Choose one focused venture narrative rather than the whole project portfolio
action_pack: Use Citizen Agents as the single application story
Turn current proof, customer funnel and public-interest impact into the application
Prepare pitch around paid operational-awareness protection plus public-sector expansion

items.headline: CERV 2026 Charter / Civic Space call
items.potential: €26m programme budget; grants for fundamental-rights and civic-space projects
items.why_fit: Citizen Agents' source-backed rights, democracy-window and civic-capacity infrastructure can fit as a technical partner in projects that strengthen civil-society capacity and practical access to rights.
blockers: A for-profit cannot coordinate this call; private non-profit coordinator required
Need a credible civil-society partner and proposal fit
Programme budget is not customer value
action_pack: Do not apply alone
Target 10 relevant NGOs/CSOs already preparing proposals
Offer Citizen Agents as technical work-package partner: monitoring, evidence, action windows and evaluation
Prepare one-page partner capability sheet

items.headline: Horizon Europe 2026 — Democracy and Governance
items.why_fit: Citizen Agents can be a technical demonstrator/data/evaluation work package for research consortia studying democratic governance, trust, rights and information integrity.
blockers: Lead time is short for a new consortium
Need exact topic match and academic/public-sector partners
action_pack: Search existing consortium partner calls rather than lead a full proposal
Offer a ready-made civic-intelligence demonstrator and evaluation layer
Create concise technical partner profile with TRL, architecture and evidence boundaries

items.headline: Dataport — KI-Assistenzsystem Sozialleistungen
items.potential: Four-year framework for AI assistance in Wohngeld and Grundsicherung workflows
items.why_fit: The requested domain—social-benefit applications—overlaps strongly with CARE, public-service eligibility work, document AI and human-in-the-loop administrative workflows.
blockers: Need full tender documents and references
Direct solo bid may be unrealistic
action_pack: Treat as partner opportunity first
Identify bidders/integrators serving Dataport and offer a specialist benefits-AI module
Prepare synthetic Wohngeld/Grundsicherung proof and compliance/evidence pack
Contact likely primes before deadline

items.headline: Reaktor.Berlin Batch 9
items.potential: €25,000 grant per selected startup plus accelerator support
items.why_fit: The programme explicitly targets technology and impact-driven projects supporting societal challenges, security, resilience or democracy.
blockers: Requires at least two co-founders for the grant
action_pack: Only pursue if team and full-time requirements genuinely fit
If yes, submit Citizen Agents rather than a multi-product portfolio
If no, mark not eligible and learn the criteria for future rounds

items.headline: Dogfood proof: BMDS / DigitalService Agentic AI Hub Round 2
items.potential: Municipal pilot access, government anchor-customer path and scaling network
items.why_fit: The programme explicitly matches Agentic-AI startups with municipalities to prototype and scale administrative automation. This is exceptionally close to the current product portfolio.
action_pack: Record as a confirmed internal blind-spot candidate
Track the Hub for the next cohort and dynamic procurement system
Contact the programme only for community/future-round participation, not as a late application
Use this miss as a product dogfood benchmark
